correctness.rationale: Exact diagonal Hessian refreshes give \(h_i^{(j)}=\lambda_i(1-\beta_2^j)\). The local unclipped limit matrix has determinant \(\beta_1\) and trace \(1+\beta_1-(1-\beta_1)\chi_i\), with \(\chi_i=\eta\lambda_i/\max\{\gamma\lambda_i,\varepsilon\}\). Second-order Jury conditions and the discriminant provide the exact strict stability frontier and rate plateau.

value.rationale: Condition-number adaptation is a defining motivation of Sophia, and the practical max-with-\(\varepsilon\) floor is absent from its simplified theory. The exact result identifies the curvature scale below which that floor restores first-order-like slowing, while also showing a broad momentum-controlled plateau with rate \(\sqrt{\beta_1}\). This is a concrete diagnostic for practical parameter choices and for interpreting the source condition-number-independence claim.
